claims.claim: A metrological framework extends GUM/VIM uncertainty evaluation to nominal properties (ML classifier outputs) using probability mass functions and summary statistics.
claims.stance_target: F: formal metrology vocabulary (VIM, GUM, measurand, nominal property) has been applied to ML classification but not to LLM confidence for code
claims.scope_conditions: ML classification; climate/earth observation and medical diagnosis examples
claims.quoted_support: Abstract: concepts related to uncertainty evaluation for nominal properties are not defined in the VIM, nor is such evaluation addressed by the Guide to the Expression of Uncertainty in Measurement (GUM).

breadth.model_families_and_sizes: classification models generically; neural network example (Sec 4.2)
breadth.calibration_metrics: not present (searched: ECE, Brier); PMF summary statistics

note: RELATED only; no LLMs, no code
